name: Create coupons for a coupon collection
description: Create coupons for a coupon collection. Add coupons to an existing coupon collection. The `coupons` array must contain between 1 and 10,000 unique coupon code strings, all associated with the specified `collectionId`. Coupon creation is processed asynchronously and a `204` status is returned immediately upon acceptance. Returns a `404` error if the specified coupon collection does not exist.

collectionId.description: The id of the coupon collection for which the coupons will be created
